title: C4 signed request (request/v1)
description: One HTTP request, signed by the client that sends it, for every client that isn't a browser: the CLI, the MCP server, host runners and units. It proves who is calling, for this farm, now, and nothing more: it is never an act, and a request that changes something carries its act beside it. It is an in-toto statement in a DSSE envelope, as every C4 record is, sent base64 in the X-C4-Request header.

subject.description: The body, by the SHA-256 of its bytes as sent. A request with no body signs the empty body's (e3b0c442...).

farm.description: The farm's ID, as an act names it: a request signed for one farm never verifies at another that trusts the same leaf.

path.description: The request target exactly as sent, in origin form: the escaped path and, with a query, ? and the raw query (/api/v1/jobs/show-a?state=running). The farm compares it byte for byte with the request line, so a client signs what it sends, and nothing is decoded or re-encoded between.

signer.description: Who sends it: the identity in the leaf certificate. A person's CLI (user/), an agent's MCP server (agent/), a unit (unit/) or a host runner (runner/).

device.description: A person's request: the device key that signed it, as the leaf's urn:c4:device: names it.

nonce.description: 16 random bytes the signer makes, base64url without padding.

signedAt.description: When the client signed, by its own clock, RFC 3339 in UTC. The farm refuses a request more than five minutes from its own clock, and takes each once.
